toto foundry connects enterprise meaning to everyday execution. Domain-owned services let the platform evolve one microservice capability at a time, while people, processes, policies, and AI work from the same current picture of the business.

Designed for consequential work

Clarity atevery step. One version of the customer

Relationships, consent, activity, cases, and ownership stay connected without forcing a new source of truth overnight.

Work that stays accountable

Long-running processes retain their context, approvals, exceptions, and evidence from the first request to the final outcome.

AI with a defined role

Agents can prepare, classify, and recommend. Policy and people control material action.

Change without a rebuild

Evolve domain models, workflows, and policies incrementally, so new capabilities build on existing operations rather than forcing a platform-wide replacement.

100% open

Open source.Forever.

toto commits toto foundry to a free and open-source core, so customers can inspect the foundation, avoid opaque lock-in, and retain a meaningful path to operate and extend it themselves.

items.title: AI Governance
items.text:
The AI software factory

AI that can help. Never run ahead.

toto foundry treats AI as a bounded enterprise capability: useful enough to accelerate the work, controlled enough to earn a place in it.

Roles, not a super-agent

Give each agent one clear job. Domain agent

Retrieves authorized context, classifies a request, and proposes the domain information or next action that is needed.

Workflow design agent

Turns approved intent into a draft state model, workflow definition, and integration dependency map.

Validation agent

Checks proposed changes against semantic constraints, policy rules, contracts, and test evidence.

Governance review agent

Prepares an explainable risk summary and required approval path. It cannot approve its own output.

Tools have contracts

No invisible permissions.

Every tool declares its input and output schema, authorization scope, side-effect class, timeout, retry behavior, idempotency key, audit event, and approval requirement. Tools that create, modify, deploy, or delete production artifacts remain behind a Conductor OSS workflow and a successful policy decision.

Autonomy, explicitly chosen

More capability only when the evidence supports it.
  1. AdvisoryAI returns analysis, drafts, evidence, and recommendations for a person to consider.
  2. AssistedAI can create sandbox artifacts that require review before any promotion or material effect.
  3. ControlledAI may invoke pre-approved, idempotent tools inside an authorized workflow with the required approvals.

Evidence by default

Every run leaves a record worth reviewing.

toto foundry records the graph and prompt version, model, retrieval references, tools, policy decision, reviewer decision, and workflow outcome. Model or agent changes are governed releases with evaluation, security review, cost limits, and rollback.

See the durable control path →

items.title: Enterprise Graph
items.text:
The semantic core

A shared language for every move your enterprise makes.

toto foundry models the business as connected meaning: who is involved, what changed, which policy applies, and why an action is allowed.

Meaning stays canonical

Context should not need to be reconstructed every time.

The enterprise graph brings shared vocabulary, relationships, semantic constraints, and model versions together. It is the common reference point for the studio, workflows, APIs, and approved AI context.

People and organizations

Model parties, legal entities, operating organizations, groups, roles, delegated authority, and assets as relationships that can evolve over time.

Customer and service context

Connect accounts, contacts, consent, agreements, products, services, cases, and ownership without flattening the relationship.

Policy and provenance

Retain the version, source, lifecycle, and semantic constraint that explain why a relationship or decision was valid.

One fact. One owner.

The graph gives meaning. Domain services own change.

Neo4j stores the ontology, organization topology, semantic metadata, and validation relationships. Each transactional business fact still has one authoritative write owner in its domain service. Read models and retrieval indexes are derived, recoverable views, never hidden systems of record.

Built for the present and the record

Relationships can change without erasing history.

Organizations combine. Departments move. Authority is delegated, expires, or is revoked. toto foundry treats these as effective-dated, versioned relationships, so an investigation can answer what was true at the time, not only what is true now.

Context, not a bypass

The graph informs action. It never quietly takes it.

Agents retrieve only authorized context. They cannot write directly to the graph or operational data. Material changes return to owned commands, policies, workflows, and accountable people.

See how context becomes design →

items.title: Studio
items.text:
The human low-code studio

Turn business intent into a working design.

toto foundry Studio is a semantic workspace for the people who know the operation best. It makes process, policy, interface, and impact visible in the same place.

Built from meaning

A design surface that starts with the business. Explore the model

Navigate the people, organizations, customer relationships, policies, and lifecycle states that give a process its meaning.

Shape the journey

Compose forms, screens, workflow steps, approvals, exceptions, assignments, and notifications from governed building blocks.

See the consequence

Review affected services, events, data constraints, approvals, and release evidence before a change becomes operational.

Human control, made practical

Review the change before the change reviews you.

The studio turns a proposed workflow or experience into a reviewable artifact. Semantic validation, policy checks, impact analysis, test evidence, and required approvals are part of the path to release, not a separate afterthought.

One shared workspace

Give every role the right kind of visibility.
  1. Domain expertsDefine terms, constraints, lifecycle rules, and the exceptions that matter to the business.
  2. Process designersBuild the journey, human decisions, handoffs, and escalation paths that move work forward.
  3. OperatorsObserve running work, resolve exceptions, and learn from the outcome without losing its history.

Designed to be governed

The studio prepares a change. It does not silently promote one.

Every production release remains versioned, testable, approval-aware, and reversible. The result is faster business design without unaccountable production behavior.

items.title: About toto
items.text:
About toto

Enterprise software should stay close to the enterprise it serves.

toto is the company building toto foundry, an AI-native enterprise operating system for organizations that need to change their operations without giving up clarity, control, or continuity.

A product with a point of view

Technology should express business intent, not obscure it.

toto builds around a simple conviction: people who are accountable for the business should be able to see, shape, and govern the software that carries the business forward. toto foundry turns that conviction into shared semantics, durable processes, clear ownership, and AI that works within explicit boundaries.

How toto foundry is built

Four principles guide the platform. Meaning before interfaces

Business entities, relationships, policy, and lifecycle are shared before screens, integrations, and automations are designed.

Authority before automation

Agents can help with the work, but owned commands, policy checks, and people remain in charge of material effects.

Evolution before replacement

Existing systems can be modernized in stages through clear contracts, migration evidence, and reversible change.

Evidence before claims

Every production capability needs accountable ownership, observability, recovery, security, and a way to prove it is ready.

Open where it matters

Built to connect. Designed to remain governable.

toto foundry uses open standards and proven open-source foundations where they provide durable value. Components remain replaceable, but the business model, contracts, controls, and tenant boundaries stay explicit.

The first toto foundry module

Prove the model where relationships matter most.

CRM is the first complete toto foundry domain module. It establishes the customer data, identity, workflow, agent, and support foundations that future domains can reuse with confidence.

Start a conversation →

items.title: CRM Capabilities
items.text:
toto foundry / first domain module

CRM that understands the whole relationship.

CRM is the first toto foundry module: a governed view of the customer, the people, organizations, relationships, decisions, and work that make every next action make sense.

Customer 360

See the customer before you act.

Bring authorized profile, account, contact, relationship, interaction, consent, activity, task, and case context together in one working view. toto foundry connects what matters without creating an uncontrolled duplicate master record.

People and organizations

Model customers, prospects, legal and operating organizations, contacts, partners, and households with stable identities and effective-dated relationships.

Relationships that explain access

Account teams, delegated access, contact roles, territories, parents, subsidiaries, and partners remain visible and governed.

Consent that travels with the work

Communication preferences, lawful purpose, suppression, and expiry stay connected to the customer before engagement begins.

Data worth trusting

Duplicate proposals, golden-record links, steward review, and data-quality status make uncertainty explicit instead of hiding it.

The work around the customer

Move the relationship forward, with context. 01 Engagement

Capture leads, opportunities, interactions, appointments, notes, and follow-ups in the lifecycle your team actually uses.

02 Service

Manage cases and requests with classification, ownership, service targets, escalation, resolution, and customer communication.

03 Guided change

Use low-code forms and workflows for onboarding, account changes, qualification, reassignment, and approved exceptions.

A governed first journey

Start where change is visible.

Choose a high-value CRM journey such as customer onboarding, account change, lead qualification, or case resolution. toto gives that journey its own API, event, workflow, approval, and audit path, so a better experience arrives with operational proof.

  1. UnderstandBring the relevant customer context, ownership, policy, and data-quality signals into view.
  2. DecideRoute the work through the right validation, exception, and human approval path.
  3. CompleteRecord the outcome, retain the evidence, and make the next interaction more informed.

AI stays assisted

Helpful by design. Controlled by policy.

AI can summarize authorized interactions, classify requests, suggest next actions, surface likely duplicates, and prepare workflow changes. It cannot send an external message, change consent, merge a customer, close a case, or make a material decision without the required policy and human approval.

How AI governance works →

The first foundation

Build the first module. Expand with confidence.

Once CRM data, workflows, integration reliability, and governance are proven, toto foundry provides the operating foundation for product, order, asset, billing, and finance modules.

Plan the first journey →

items.title: Platform Overview
items.text:
toto foundry / platform

One operating model. Six clear responsibilities.

toto foundry connects enterprise meaning, human design, governed AI, and durable execution without asking one layer to do every job.

Designed to stay legible

Every layer has a purpose. Enterprise graph

Defines the shared language of people, organizations, customers, relationships, policies, and business context.

Explore the graph → Human studio

Lets domain experts shape forms, workflows, policy-aware experiences, and releases from the business model.

Explore the studio → Domain services and events

Own authoritative commands and publish versioned business facts through APIs, GraphQL, and Kafka.

Workflow and AI controls

Keep long-running work durable and give agents bounded roles, typed tools, policy checks, and approval gates.

Explore AI governance →

A governed path for change

A business change follows a path you can inspect.
  1. CommandAn owned domain API validates an authorized request and updates its transactional source of truth.
  2. EventA versioned fact is published through a reliable outbox, retaining tenant, correlation, and classification context.
  3. WorkflowConductor OSS carries durable progress, waits, retries, compensation, and approval state across systems and time.

AI in its place

Reasoning can be useful without becoming authority.

A LangGraph agent can retrieve authorized semantic context, prepare a proposal, or validate an artifact. It returns structured evidence and recommendations. It does not write directly to a database, publish to an event stream, or bypass the policy and approval path for a material action.

Open by design

Interoperable foundations. Accountable execution.

Neo4j, Conductor OSS, Apache Kafka, GraphQL, FastAPI or Apollo, and LangGraph each own a clear concern. Open standards keep the platform connected, while versioned contracts and policy controls keep it governable.

See the workflow runtime →

items.title: Workflow Runtime
items.text:
The workflow runtime

Work that waits. Remembers. Recovers.

toto foundry keeps consequential work moving across people, systems, time, and failure without losing the reason a decision was made.

More than a request

A process can outlast the moment that started it. Durable state

Conductor OSS retains workflow progress, identity, policy decision, approval state, and correlation across the full life of the work.

Human decisions

Approval waits preserve the proposal, evidence, policy result, approver, and final decision rather than reducing judgment to a checkbox.

Recovery by design

Retries, timeouts, escalation, compensation, and transparent pending states are part of the workflow, not emergency patches.

A clean division of work

Commands change state. Events carry facts. Workflows coordinate time.
  1. Own the commandA domain service validates, authorizes, and changes its authoritative business state.
  2. Publish the factKafka distributes a versioned event through a reliable outbox, ready for replay and correlation.
  3. Coordinate the outcomeConductor OSS drives the durable process and invokes bounded AI only where reasoning is genuinely useful.

Correctness over appearances

No false success.

When a dependency is unavailable, toto foundry waits, retries, compensates, escalates, or makes the pending state clear. It does not invent a completed outcome, silently lose the work, or let a model choose an irreversible shortcut.

Traceable by default

Every outcome has a path back to its evidence.

Workflow history connects the initiating identity, event, policy, approvals, agent activity, exception handling, and result. Operations teams can intervene with context, and auditors can understand what happened without reconstructing the story from logs.

items.title: Why toto
items.text:
Why toto

Make change a native capability.

The enterprise already knows how it works. toto creates toto foundry so that knowledge can become better software, better workflows, and better decisions.

The problem is not one more application

Business change gets lost between systems.

Customer data fragments. Rules drift into private spreadsheets and custom code. Work crosses teams without shared context. The result is a business that changes faster than the software meant to support it.

A different operating model

Start with meaning. Keep people in authority. Business meaning comes first

A shared model anchors people, relationships, policies, and lifecycle states before applications and agents interpret them.

AI has defined boundaries

Agents contribute evidence, options, and preparation. People and policy retain control of material business action.

Change can be inspected

Commands, events, workflows, approvals, and outcomes stay connected, so the organization can improve without losing accountability.

CRM is the first toto foundry module

Begin where the business already feels the friction.

toto foundry starts with the customer relationship: trusted customer context, consent-aware engagement, case and task workflows, and AI assistance under human control. Once CRM is proven, the same operating model can extend to product, order, service, asset, billing, and finance modules.

Explore the CRM foundation →

The outcome

Less translation. More movement.

toto helps an enterprise change with clearer business meaning, faster operating design, safer automation, and evidence that holds up when the work matters.
